body: Can you use another compiler or do you _have_ to use AppleClang?
I don't see the relevance, but in general you can change the compiler by setting the `CC` and `CXX` environment variables. However, Apple Clang is the platform compiler for macOS.
True, I was just asking to give you a workaround just in case.
I try to install other ports's feature, and get the same error: `zsh: no matches found: port[feature]`. Could you please confirm this? @strega-nil
@LilyWangL That is because your shell is interpreting the `[]` as a wildcard. I am using zsh as well, try putting it into quotes, like: `vcpkg install "sdl2-mixer[libflac,libogg,mpg123]"`

hmm... on the one hand, I'm not sure if we should support pre-Catalina macOS. I don't think Apple supports previous versions of macOS. On the other hand, I can see that someone might want this to be a feature; it may make sense to make this a default feature, as opposed to _always_ working.

@kevinlul If you'd like to change this, I'd be happy to merge a PR that makes native MIDI support a default feature. That should fix it.

Apple generally supports the last three released major versions. As of writing, 10.13 High Sierra has extended support until September. Thus, Homebrew tests the most recent three versions and ships bottles for those. I can look more in-depth into how this can be patched but in the meantime I've locally reverted the PR that introduced the regression for my uses.
Hmm, good to know. Thanks @kevinlul, it's really hard to figure out exactly what macOS versions are supported.

repository.name: vcpkg
repository.description: C++ Library Manager for Windows, Linux, and MacOS

issue.body:
With the libFLAC update in #11152, downstream packages must define `FLAC__NO_DLL` if linking statically to get the correct symbols on Windows. In the original pull request, this was updated for only libsndfile, so this might need to be updated for all downstream ports. I noticed this regression trying to static link an executable to SDL2_mixer with the FLAC backend.

Secondly, native MIDI is now a default feature per #10318, though now I can no longer reproduce that problem locally -- only on Catalina GitHub Actions.

Does your PR follow the [maintainer guide](https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg/blob/master/docs/maintainers/maintainer-guide.md)? Yes
